hero.title: Come find us
hero.subtitle: Tucked just off the high street, two minutes from the Grand Arcade. Look for the Victorian barrow — you can't miss it.

highlight.title: Two spots. Forty years. Countless hot dogs.
highlight.subtitle: The same corners of Cambridge since 1986 — rain or shine, we're here.

directions.title: Easy to reach, hard to leave
directions.subtitle: Two kiosks, both in the heart of Cambridge — pick whichever is easier for you.

walking.title: On foot
walking.description: We're at Pitch 14 on Fitzroy Street, a short walk from the Grafton Centre and Christ's Pieces. About ten minutes from the city centre.

cycling.title: By bike
cycling.description: Bike racks along Fitzroy Street and Burleigh Street. Lock up by the Grafton Centre and you're 30 seconds away.

driving.title: By car
driving.description: Grafton Centre car park (CB1 1PS) is the closest — 3 minute walk to the barrow from the exit.

items.busStation: Drummer St Bus Station — 5 min walk

walking.title: On foot
walking.description: We're on Market Passage, just off the high street between Petty Cury and Market Square. Follow the smell.

cycling.title: By bike
cycling.description: Bike racks on Market Square and the Grand Arcade multi-storey. Lock up and walk 30 seconds.

driving.title: By car
driving.description: Grand Arcade car park (CB2 3BJ) is the closest — 2 minute walk to the barrow from the exit.
